name: Cord Weave
description: Weave three cords of qi into one rope round a foe's arms in a single motion.

name: Rope Guard
description: Coil a rope of qi round the forearm to take a heavy cut without breaking.

name: Hook Throw
description: Throw a hooked line to a far ledge and swing to it in one arc.

name: Strain Sense
description: Judge from the creak of a line how near it is to parting.

name: Heavy Coil
description: Wind a thick coil of qi round a foe's body and tighten it on every outbreath.

name: Rope Reflect
description: Whirl a rope to catch a thrown spear and fling it back along the line it came.

name: Greater Cinch
description: Close a great rope round a strong foe and keep tightening until the arms are pinned to the ribs.

name: Rope Sweep
description: Sweep a heavy rope through a half circle and bind every foe it brushes.

name: Swarm Thread
description: Release a spray of fine threads that each catch a different foe's sleeve.

name: Many Knots
description: Hold five knots at once on five targets with a steady count of breath.

name: Strand Screen
description: Flick threads at a volley of small missiles to snag each one in the air.

name: Head Count
description: Count every live tie spun from the user by the tug on each thread.

name: Spread Tether
description: Spread a single tether into many ends and fix each to a different foe's limb.

name: Linked Stagger
description: Tug one tether so all the foes bound by it stagger together.

name: Taut Chorus
description: Tie several allies to one calm line so the strongest rhythm steadies the whole group.

name: Multitude Tie
description: Hold a dozen foes at once by threads running from a single anchor in the user's hand.

name: Cord Storm
description: Loose a storm of whipping threads in every direction that cut and tangle each foe in reach.

name: Spun Thread
description: Draw a thread out of the qi field and tie it round a foe's limb.

name: Yielding Knot
description: Tie a knot in the field around the user so that a blow binds itself up in it.

name: Tether Stride
description: Cast a line through the field to a target spot and follow it there.

name: Bond Gauge
description: Feel every bond that crosses the qi field around the user.

name: Outer Bond
description: Hold a bond on a foe beyond arm's reach with no visible cord.

name: Dragging Weave
description: Fill a patch of the field with binding qi so every step through it drags.

name: Bodiless Fetter
description: Close a fetter of pure qi on a foe with no rope or knot to cut.

name: Mass Seizure
description: Cast the binding through the whole field at once so each foe in it is tied where it stands.

name: Mirror Loop
description: Cast a loop on a foe's left wrist and its twin on the right so both hands close.

name: Twin Guard
description: Raise two guards of qi side by side so a blow that breaks one meets the other.

name: Hopping Tether
description: Step along two tethers in turn so the body crosses ground in alternate bounds.

name: Twin Sense
description: Feel both ends of a tether at once to learn what each end is doing.

name: Paired Pull
description: Pull two foes toward each other along one tether until they collide.

name: Matched Return
description: Answer a blow with a matching strike sent along a tether back to its source.

name: Twin Tether
description: Hold two foes on twin tethers so that moving one drags the other with it.

name: Twin Fetter
description: Close fetters on two limbs at once and wrench them apart with a single tug.

name: Talon Hook
description: Hook a barbed thread of qi into a foe's clothing and pull the foe off balance.

name: Hawk Perch
description: Perch the weight on one braced leg tied to the ground by a hidden line.

name: Keen Thread
description: Send a keen thread ahead to find the hidden ties of a laid trap.

name: Swoop Tether
description: Cast a line to a high point and swoop down it in a short glide.

name: Talon Strike
description: Strike with fingers hooked in a talon while a cord snaps taut at the moment of contact.

name: Grasping Tether
description: Seize a foe at range with a tether and hold the foe's feet clear of the ground.

name: Hawk Cinch
description: Drop a cinch from above that closes round a foe's shoulders like a diving claw.

name: Tether Intercept
description: Snare a flying weapon in mid air with a line cast beyond the user's arm.

name: Raptor Seizure
description: Seize a foe in a great claw of qi cords and lift the foe clear of the ground.

name: Talon Rend
description: Drive tight cords through a foe's guard like talons and tear the stance open.

name: Cupped Knot
description: Gather qi into a basin round a foe's feet and close it like a knot.

name: Flowing Tether
description: Run a line from a flowing gesture and glide down it in one long step.

name: Pooled Guard
description: Pool qi in front of the user so a blow sinks into it and slows.

name: Drift Reading
description: Read the drift of every bond in the field like a current under a surface.

name: Flowing Bond
description: Let a bond flow along a foe's limbs and close each joint in turn.

name: Settling Hold
description: Let bound foes sink into the pooled field until their every motion slows.

name: Cupped Hold
description: Fill a wide basin of binding qi so that everyone in it is held at the knee.

name: Sweeping Binding
description: Loose a river of bindings that sweeps through a line of foes and ties each as it passes.

name: Swift Hitch
description: Throw a hitch with the wind at its back and catch a fleeing foe's ankle.

name: Steady Bearing
description: Hold a firm bearing tied to the ground so gusts of force cannot turn the stance.

name: Gust Draw
description: Draw along a tether the instant a gust of qi blows and cross ground in one rush.

name: Sworn Feel
description: Feel whether a sworn bond near the user is whole or breaking.

name: Wind Cord
description: Spin a cord of qi on the air itself and loop it round a distant foe.

name: Steady Tie
description: Tie an ally to the user's bearing so the ally keeps a steady stance through a hard push.

name: Return Gust
description: Tie a cord to a gust of force and turn it away before it lands.

name: Sworn Tether
description: Tie a foe to a sworn line that tightens with each step the foe takes toward the user's allies.

name: Squall Lashing
description: Whip a squall of lashing cords outward that snatch up each foe the gust touches.

name: Oath Knot
description: Tie a sworn knot on a foe's arm that tightens whenever the foe pulls against it.

name: Held Word
description: Hold a promise at the chest as a guard that does not break while the user keeps faith.

name: Calm Pledge
description: Speak a plain pledge to an ally and settle a calm hold on the ally's nerves.

name: Pledge Feel
description: Feel whether a pledge near the user is being kept or broken.

name: Oath Hold
description: Hold a foe to the terms of a spoken oath with a binding that grows with each step against it.

name: Sworn Return
description: Send a foe's blow back by the bond of a promise the foe has just broken.

name: Oath Held Fast
description: Seal a foe's technique with an oath that holds until the foe or the binder yields.

name: Pledge Fetters
description: Cast fetters on a foe that tighten each time the foe reaches for a forbidden strike.

name: Tilting Cord
description: Cast a line along the foe's flank and draw the foe off the edge of balance.

name: Bearing Brace
description: Take a bearing and tie the stance to it so the user cannot be moved.

name: Long Cast
description: Cast a long line to a distant mark and pull across to it.

name: Range Sense
description: Judge by the weight of a line how far its far end lies.

name: Distant Hold
description: Keep a tether on a foe at the end of a very long line while the user moves freely.

name: Anchored Bearing
description: Tie allies to the user's held bearing so their steps keep one line.

name: Hauling Pull
description: Haul on a long tether at the instant a foe lifts a foot and spoil the step.

name: Long Tether
description: Hold a foe at the far end of an unbroken tether across a wide stretch and reel the foe in slowly.

name: Tether Snare
description: Lay a long hidden tether in the ground that closes on the first foe to step over it.
